title: Schedule gallery
intro: Find a base schedule, inspect the details, then bring a copy into your workbench.
addDescription: Import a .riic.json schedule file (up to 256 KB). Saved only in this browser; not published.
emptyHint: Try a different query or layout, or clear filters. Bookmarks and uploads are saved here.
sampleDescription: Preview, bookmark and import this example into the workbench. Adjust it to your roster and play times.
copyNotice: Opens an editable schedule copy. Your personal roster and draft are preserved.
sampleWarning: This example demonstrates the gallery and is not a verified production recommendation. Check training levels, assignments and morale, then recalculate before use.
matchHint: Import a personal roster to see missing operators.
storageError: Browser storage is unavailable or full. Download your schedules as a backup.
fileLimit: Choose a schedule JSON file up to 256 KB.
libraryFull: The local gallery holds up to 20 schedules. Remove an unused entry first.
duplicate: This schedule is already in your local gallery.
added: Added to the local gallery. Visible only in this browser.
openError: Could not open the schedule copy. Download the file and import it manually.
reviewFlow: Authors submit schedules for administrator review. Editing published content requires review again.
notesPlaceholder: Describe layout, training requirements, replacement conditions and caveats.
backupHint: Select an original operator, then up to 5 alternatives. Alternatives do not guarantee equivalent production, synergies or morale. Fiammetta cannot be replaced while enabled.
backupLimit: Choose up to 5 alternatives per operator.
noBackups: No alternatives specified by the author.
shareAuthorBox: Share author roster for a full comparison
shareBoxHint: Shares owned operators, promotion, level and potential, never account credentials. Uses your current roster, or retains the previous snapshot if unavailable. Leave off to share only schedule requirements.
signInSubmit: Sign in to submit for review. You can still save a local copy.
editRequiresReview: Edited published content is removed from the public list until approved again.
submissionInvalid: Invalid content or save failed. Check title, alternatives and roster, or refresh and retry.
requestFailed: Could not complete this action. Check your connection, refresh and retry. Existing schedules are preserved.
allOwned: You own every operator required by this schedule.
trainingGap: Mine E{actualElite} Lv.{actualLevel} → Schedule E{expectedElite} Lv.{expectedLevel}
boxNotShared: The author has not shared their full roster. Comparing schedule requirements only.
replacementWarning: Selections update the preview and are applied only to your copy. Duplicate assignments in a shift block import. Recalculate production and morale after replacements.
communityUnavailable: Community schedules are unavailable. Examples and local schedules remain accessible.
submitted: Submitted. View status under My submissions.
revisionConflict: This schedule has changed. Refresh and review the latest version.
communityNotice: Only reviewed schedules are public · Full rosters require author opt-in
rejectReason: A rejection reason is required so the author can revise.
backupConflict: Alternatives cause duplicate assignments or the replacement plan is invalid. Adjust before importing.
unknownTraining: Training requirements are missing for {count} operators, so their training gaps cannot be evaluated.
adminDescription: Review submissions, leave feedback, publish schedules and remove them from the gallery.
adminLoadFailed: Could not load reviews. Check your administrator access and network, then retry.
adminImportHint: Choose a .riic.json file, then check its notes and alternatives before publishing.
adminReviewHint: Check assignments, author notes and alternatives. Rejections require a reason. Edited submissions require another review.
adminBoxShared: The author opted to share a snapshot of {count} operators.
comparisonBoxHint: Choose MAA JSON or a compatible Excel file (up to 10 MB). Used on this page only; never uploaded or used to overwrite your personal roster.
comparisonFileLimit: Choose a roster file up to 10 MB.
comparisonBoxInvalid: Could not read this roster. Check its format and training levels. The previous comparison roster is preserved.
comparisonPrivate: Used only for filtering, comparison and alternative operator training on this page. Never replaces or publishes your full roster. Refreshing restores your current personal roster.
scanBoxDescription: Sign in to your website account, then authorize with the Skland app or choose an already connected character.
websiteLoginFirst: Sign in to your website account first. Skland authorization will continue here without leaving this schedule.
scanBoxHint: Uses the existing Skland account-binding flow. Retrieved operators are used for comparison, never automatically published or used to replace this schedule.
sklandBoxLoadFailed: Could not load the Skland roster. Check sign-in and network, then retry.
sklandBoxMissing: Authorization completed, but valid operator data was not returned. Your previous comparison roster is preserved. Refresh and retry.
